title: Simple Skies
description: Simple Skies is a fair Skyblock server with monthly real cash prizes, no pay-to-win, no ranks, and no spawners. Build your island, trade with players, and compete in a fully player-driven economy.
body:
Simple Skies is a clean, competitive Skyblock server built around fair gameplay, skill, grinding, and a fully player-driven economy. Every month, players have the chance to compete for real cash prizes, making each season exciting without turning the server into pay-to-win.

Our goal is to keep Skyblock simple, balanced, and enjoyable for everyone. That means no pay-to-win perks, no overpowered ranks, and no spawners flooding the economy. Every island grows through real effort, smart trading, teamwork, and strategy.

Whether you enjoy building, farming, selling, competing, or climbing the island leaderboard, Simple Skies gives every player a fair chance to succeed. The economy is shaped by the community, not by paid advantages, so your progress depends on how you play—not how much you spend.

Our promise to you:

Never any P2W
Never any ranks
Never any spawners
A fair, player-driven economy
Monthly real cash prizes
Simple, competitive Skyblock gameplay

Join the community and start building your island today.

Visit simpleskies.org for more details!
